system.description:
Favoured weapon: Dagger

Granted power: Advantage on all Knowledge and Lore checks.

  • Once/day: ask the GM one yes/no question about the current situation and receive a truthful answer.
  • Once per encounter, as part of your action, learn one resistance, vulnerability or immunity of a creature you can see.

Allegiance: Neutral Good, the god's alignment, held while the god favours you. Tenets: on Mystra in the World of Arneyan wiki.
